### The Test of Integrity
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-october-12-2023.html
Passage: Genesis 47:20-22
Points:
- Facing a desperate populace with depleted resources, Joseph preserved their dignity and treated them with respect.
- Rather than offering handouts, he accepted their livestock and land in an equitable exchange for grain.
- Joseph never abused his absolute authority over vulnerable people who were entirely at his mercy.
- Remembering his own deliverance from slavery, he recognized that much is required of those given great influence.
- True integrity restrains people in power from taking unfair advantage of others during times of crisis.

### The Beloved Leader
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/beloved-leader
Passage: Genesis 47:25
Points:
- Joseph created a manageable arrangement where Pharaoh received a fifth of the harvest and the people kept eighty percent.
- Instead of viewing Joseph as a cruel master, the Egyptians embraced him as a savior who preserved their lives.
- The Egyptians' grateful posture toward Joseph provides a model for how Christians should treat leaders who nourish them.
- Pastors carry heavy burdens shepherding the flock and need willing cooperation rather than a critical spirit.
- Church members support their leaders best when they actively use their own gifts to minister to the congregation.
